description: The plot illustrates the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” for two vision-language models—LlaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen2-VL-7B—evaluated on two safety benchmarks, FigStep and MMSafetyBench, across four sample sizes: 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The x-axis, labeled with sample sizes, is presented on a linear scale with tick marks at 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis, labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1, also on a linear scale. The blue line with circular markers, representing “LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep,” begins at approximately 0.20 at 128, rises to about 0.25 at 256, reaches 0.35 at 512, and plateaus at approximately 0.36 at 1024. The orange line with square markers, “Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep,” starts at roughly 0.15 at 128, jumps to 0.24 at 256, climbs to 0.42 at 512, and remains stable at 0.42 through 1024. The green line with triangular markers, “LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench,” begins at approximately 0.07 at 128, increases to 0.21 at 256, rises to 0.37 at 512, and stabilizes at 0.38 at 1024. The red line with diamond markers, “Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench,” starts at 0.24 at 128, rises to 0.27 at 256, reaches 0.42 at 512, and continues increasing slightly to 0.52 at 1024. A legend in the bottom right corner maps each line’s color and marker to its corresponding model and benchmark.
caption_used: The plot illustrates the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio' across different sample sizes for two models on two benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled with sample sizes, presented on a linear scale with tick marks at values 128, 256, 512, and 1024. The y-axis represents the 'Harmful with Refusal Ratio,' also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. The blue line, representing 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep,' starts at approximately 0.2 at 128, increases steadily to about 0.4 at 512, and remains constant through 1024. The orange line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep,' begins at around 0.15, rises sharply to approximately 0.45 at 512, and stabilizes at that level through 1024. The green line, 'LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench,' starts at approximately 0.08 and rises to nearly 0.4 by 512, remaining constant thereafter. The red line, 'Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench,' begins at 0.25, reaches approximately 0.45 at 512, and slightly increases to 0.5 at 1024. There is a legend available at the bottom right of the plot to map different line styles to their labels.
